name: Demetrius
troparia: (Tone 3) In you, O martyr Demetrius,* the world has discovered a champion in its travails,* for you have routed the nations* and so, as you smashed the pride of Lyaeus,* encouraging Nestor to struggle,* pray to Christ our God to grant great mercy to our souls.

(Tone 8) You Who look upon the earth and make it quake,* deliver us from the menace of the horrible earthquake, O Christ our Lord,* and grant us Your rich mercies* by the prayers of the God-bearer, and save us.
kontakia: (Tone 2) With the streams of your blood, O Demetrius,* God, who gave you invincible strength,* has dyed the Church in royal crimson* and preserved your city invulnerable* for you are its fortification.

(Tone 6) Deliver us, O Lord, from a terrible earthquake* and from unbearable disease sent for our sins.* Have mercy, O Lord, on the faithful kings (rulers) and Your people,* whom You have gained by Your blood.* O Master, do not let Your city perish through a horrible earthquake,* for we know no other God but You,* and You cry out to us: "I am with you, and no one is against you!"
